name: Vyapar Books PRO
releaseNotes: App updates now use signed GitHub release assets only, with SHA-256 verification
If a release has no Android APK asset, the update dialog opens the GitHub release page instead of using a stale raw APK
Release verification now checks the APK version, signature, and checksums before publishing
CI builds the production bundle before running the full test suite, so clean checkouts verify correctly
No accounting, tax, sync, or local data behavior changed in this update
